items.difficulty_reason: 59 行（含 18 行陈述）、典范映射构造 + 两个可逆情形：K-injective 代表元上的三段链（合成引理——其上 Hick 分离+lft 假设由 proper h 满足；proper 恒等）+ 挠环情形经局部化、维数有界、有限上同调维数归约到 stalk 消没（f_! stalk 支撑于闭点 + proper base change + 闭点支撑消没引理）。软点披露：(a) 情形为平行情形指针（引用另一证明的同一论证并指明替换的引理）；作者明言「separated 情形是前一引理特例、建议读者跳过一般情形证明」。无 verbatim omit。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-shriek-lqf-and-proper (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 3178-3195

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: construct the map on K-injective representatives through the chain g_! = h_!f_! = h_*f_! followed by h_* of the K-injective resolution, the first equality from the composition lemma (whose hypothesis that the upper morphism be separated and locally of finite type is met by the proper h) and the second from properness; invertibility in the torsion ring case: work locally on Z, bound the fibre dimension, use the finite cohomological dimension of Rh_*, and reduce to the vanishing of R^qh_*(f_!F) for q > 0, which follows from the stalk description of f_! (stalks supported where the extension of residue fields is finite), the proper base change theorem, and vanishing for sheaves supported in closed points; the bounded-below torsion case follows by the same argument as in the earlier exchange lemma with the stalk lemma substituted (source lines 3197-3255)
